scope: C1 queue (derived texts, arm loop over the real C1 grade, parsers, budget) hub and exact pinned-container CPU tests; no box or GPU evidence

leaves.name: c1-arm-loop-clients
leaves.replaces: e3_alpha_c1_box.py arm and e3_native39_trunk_checks.py at the bash seam
leaves.equivalence: C0's stubs (test_alpha_perf_queue.STUB_BOX, STUB_CHECKS) with the module name changed to e3_alpha_c1_box: the question is the loop's control flow (order, band manifest per round, budget skip, death watch); the watch and the C1 grade are real.
leaves.cannot_prove: Anything about the clients' behaviour against an engine

leaves.name: c1-arm-loop-connected-run
leaves.replaces: The arm records and the followed engine logs of a box run
leaves.equivalence: test_alpha_c1_box's connected run (one OverlapStack per declared arm, the real overlap driver, controller, bridges and emitters) with that file's declared leaves (stage_overlap_fixture_leaves.json: one-engine-numbering, decode-live-count, fake-cuda-allocator, selection-by-attribute, arm-record-box-fields); its records are copied by the stub arm client and its lines written as engine-stream.log/err. A cut run keeps the arms that ran and the lines up to the last one's end.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real arm records, real box log interleaving and real timings

leaves.name: c1-arm-loop-box-tools
leaves.replaces: nvidia-smi, docker, systemctl and health_ok on the box
leaves.equivalence: Same leaf as test_alpha_perf_queue.ArmLoop and test_alpha_c0_queue.ArmLoop.

leaves.name: c1-arm-loop-clock
leaves.replaces: Box time before the arm entry guard
leaves.equivalence: The guard compares bash SECONDS with the real alpha_c1_gate.LAST_ARM_ENTRY_S. Assigning SECONDS after a named step moves the variable the guard reads.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real arm durations; the expected offsets come from alpha-perf box walls (alpha_c1_gate.BOX_WALLS_S), not from C1 arms

leaves.name: c1-argparse-capture
leaves.equivalence: As test_alpha_c0_queue.Commands: the real parser parses the derived command line, then the capture raises before main acts.
leaves.cannot_prove: What the module does with the parsed arguments

leaves.name: c1-grade-without-regrouping
leaves.replaces: e3_alpha_c1_box.regrouping (box.regrouping patched to the identity, so progress.assemble runs unwrapped)
leaves.equivalence: A fault injection, not a stand-in: the grade must refuse an overlap arm whose engine flushes are not regrouped by its stage-overlap lines (regrouped-chunk-without-two-opens-and-two-releases, verdict INC) and still pass the serial arm.
leaves.cannot_prove: Nothing about the real regroup beyond what the passing grade tests prove
